_description: Persistent world facts the party has changed or learned. Append-only in practice — flipping a flag back should be rare and noted.

cragmaw_hideout_scouted.note: Party cleared the entrance sentries and prisoner cave. Klarg and ledge goblins untouched. Sildar rescued.

gundren_rescued.note: Freed from Grol's tower. Travels with the party as NPC from session 6.

map_to_wave_echo_recovered.note: Taken back from Vyerith at the plank-bridge ambush. Gundren carries it.

cragmaw_castle_grol_bargain.note: Grol alive (22/45), keeps his castle, gave the party safe passage + the ambush route. Not an ally — a debt-neutral truce. Spared hobgoblin sentry alive inside.

vyerith_captured.note: Doppelganger courier alive, bound, prisoner at party camp. The Black Spider does not yet know.

tresendar_manor_cleared.note: Set true when party defeats Glasstaff and clears the Redbrand hideout.
